============================================================================
AUDIT NOTE -- READ BEFORE RUNNING
============================================================================
This file consolidates 05_descriptive_statistics, 06_crossbasis_selection,
07_DLNM_diagnostics, 07A_sensitivity_analysis, and 08_fit_centre_models into
one script, with every repeated fit/QAIC/MMT/kappa block factored into a
single function (run_dlnm_spec()). No model-fitting logic is duplicated
anywhere below.

DECISION ENFORCED BY THIS SCRIPT (not left open):
  max_lag = 21, exposure_df = 3, lag_df = 3 (logknots)

Why, using the real diagnostics already observed on this dataset:
  - Lag-window search (exposure_df=3 fixed): 21d gave the best QAIC (123642.6)
    among {3,7,14,21,28}, with kappa=265 -- the lowest kappa of the two
    longest, best-fitting windows (21d vs 28d: kappa 265 vs 297).
  - df sensitivity at lag=21 fixed: QAIC keeps improving as exposure_df rises
    to 5, but kappa explodes from ~265 (df3) to ~2315 (df5), and MMT
    collapses from ~24 deg C to ~17 deg C. That MMT is not a real shift in
    biology -- it is a numerical-instability artifact of an
    over-parameterised, collinear crossbasis. df=3/lag_df=3 is the simplest
    specification inside the stable region (kappa < 500, MMT inside the
    5th-95th pctile of observed UTCI), which is exactly the decision rule
    this script enforces programmatically in Section 2.
  - Cross-check: the lag-window grid (exposure_df=3, auto lag basis) and the
    exposure/lag-df grid (lag=21 fixed) independently agree on MMT ~ 24 deg C
    and QAIC ~ 123,643 at this same specification -- two different grid
    searches landing on the same answer is real signal, not coincidence.
  - phi (dispersion) is ~0.85 across *every* candidate spec -- it does not
    discriminate between models here, so it is reported as a sanity check
    but NOT used in the composite ranking score.
  - External plausibility check: MMT ~ 24 deg C UTCI is close to the
    published arid-climate-zone MMT (~24.5 deg C, Tobias et al. 2021,
    Environ Epidemiol), consistent with the Sahelian sites in this cohort.

If you re-run the grid searches in Section 2 on updated data and they
disagree with this locked spec, READ THE OUTPUT before overriding
`LOCKED_SPEC` below -- don't silently accept a lower-QAIC/higher-kappa
alternative, per the same reasoning above.
============================================================================
-->

# 0. Shared helper functions (used by every section below)

Every model-fitting / QAIC / MMT / kappa computation in this pipeline goes
through this single function, so there is exactly one place that logic can
be wrong, instead of five copies that can each be wrong differently.

```{r helpers}
## ---- lag basis selection ------------------------------------------------
build_lag_basis <- function(max_lag, lag_df = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(lag_df)) {
    return(list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(max_lag, nk = lag_df)))
  }
  # sensible default if lag_df not specified (used only for exploratory
  # lag-window scans, never for the locked/final model)
  if (max_lag <= 3)  return(list(fun = "integer"))
  if (max_lag <= 7)  return(list(fun = "ns", df = 2))
  if (max_lag <= 14) return(list(fun = "ns", df = 3))
  list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(max_lag, nk = 3))
}

## ---- QAIC, the standard Gasparrini/Armstrong quasi-AIC -------------------
## (log-likelihood based -- NOT the deviance+2*p*phi approximation used in
## earlier exploratory code; this is the version used in published DLNM
## tutorials and is what the composite Score in Section 2 relies on)
compute_qaic <- function(fit) {
  phi    <- summary(fit)$dispersion
  loglik <- sum(dpois(fit$y, fit$fitted.values, log = TRUE))
  edf    <- summary(fit)$df[3]
  -2 * loglik + 2 * edf * phi
}

## ---- one function to fit ANY (max_lag, exposure_df, lag_df) combination --
run_dlnm_spec <- function(data,
                           max_lag,
                           exposure_df,
                           lag_df       = NULL,
                           exposure_var = EXPOSURE_VAR,
                           outcome_var  = OUTCOME_VAR,
                           stratum_var  = STRATUM_VAR,
                           lag_prefix   = LAG_PREFIX,
                           mmt_probs    = c(.01, .99),
                           by           = 0.1,
                           quiet        = TRUE) {

  lag_cols <- paste0(lag_prefix, 0:max_lag)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(lag_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    warning("Missing lag columns for max_lag=", max_lag, ": ",
            paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
    return(NULL)
  }

  lag_matrix <- as.matrix(data[, lag_cols])
  keep <- complete.cases(lag_matrix)
  dat  <- data[keep, ]
  lag_matrix <- lag_matrix[keep, ]
  if (!quiet) cat("max_lag=", max_lag, " exposure_df=", exposure_df,
                   " lag_df=", ifelse(is.null(lag_df), "auto", lag_df),
                   " | rows retained:", nrow(dat), "\n")

  var_knots <- equalknots(dat[[exposure_var]], fun = "ns", df = exposure_df)
  lag_basis <- build_lag_basis(max_lag, lag_df)

  cb <- tryCatch(
    crossbasis(lag_matrix, lag = max_lag,
               argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
               arglag = lag_basis),
    error = function(e) { message("crossbasis failed: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(cb)) return(NULL)

  fit <- tryCatch(
    gnm(as.formula(paste0(outcome_var, " ~ cb")),
        eliminate = factor(dat[[stratum_var]]),
        family = quasipoisson(), data = dat),
    error = function(e) { message("gnm failed: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  pred <- tryCatch(crosspred(cb, fit, by = by, model.link = "log"),
                    error = function(e) NULL)

  q <- quantile(dat[[exposure_var]], mmt_probs, na.rm = TRUE)
  MMT <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(pred)) {
    idx <- pred$predvar >= q[1] & pred$predvar <= q[2]
    if (any(idx)) MMT <- pred$predvar[idx][which.min(pred$allRRfit[idx])]
  }

  kappa_val <- tryCatch(kappa(cb), error = function(e) NA_real_)

  list(
    data = dat, cb = cb, fit = fit, pred = pred,
    diagnostics = tibble(
      max_lag = max_lag, exposure_df = exposure_df,
      lag_df = ifelse(is.null(lag_df), NA_integer_, lag_df),
      converged = isTRUE(fit$converged),
      QAIC  = compute_qaic(fit),
      phi   = summary(fit)$dispersion,
      MMT   = round(MMT, 2),
      rank  = qr(cb)$rank, n_basis = ncol(cb),
      kappa = round(kappa_val, 1)
    )
  )
}

## ---- MCDA-style decision filter (kappa, MMT plausibility; phi excluded
##      per the audit note -- it does not discriminate on this dataset) ----
apply_decision_rule <- function(tbl, kappa_max = 500, mmt_range) {
  tbl %>%
    filter(converged, kappa < kappa_max,
           MMT >= mmt_range[1], MMT <= mmt_range[2]) %>%
    mutate(
      QAIC_rank  = rank(QAIC),
      Kappa_rank = rank(kappa),
      MMT_dev    = abs(MMT - median(MMT)),
      MMT_rank   = rank(MMT_dev),
      Score      = QAIC_rank + Kappa_rank + MMT_rank
    ) %>%
    arrange(Score)
}

## ---- overlay any set of run_dlnm_spec() results on one RR plot ----------
plot_curve_overlay <- function(results, labels, title = "") {
  ok <- !sapply(results, is.null)
  results <- results[ok]; labels <- labels[ok]
  x_rng <- range(unlist(lapply(results, \(r) r$pred$predvar)), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- range(unlist(lapply(results, \(r) r$pred$allRRfit)), na.rm = TRUE)
  cols <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, length(results)), "Dark2")
  plot(NULL, xlim = x_rng, ylim = y_rng, xlab = "UTCI", ylab = "Cumulative RR",
       main = title)
  abline(h = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey40")
  for (i in seq_along(results)) {
    lines(results[[i]]$pred$predvar, results[[i]]$pred$allRRfit,
          col = cols[i], lwd = 2)
  }
  legend("topright", legend = labels, col = cols[seq_along(results)],
         lwd = 2, bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
}
```

# 2. Crossbasis selection with a multi-criteria decision framework (`06_crossbasis_selection`)

Per the audit note: QAIC alone is not the decision rule. A candidate must
also be numerically stable (kappa) and yield a biologically plausible,
in-range MMT before QAIC is even consulted.

## 2.1 Lag-window scan (exposure_df fixed at 3, lag basis auto-selected)

```{r lag-window-scan}
lag_window_results <- map(
  c(3, 7, 14, 21, 28),
  ~ run_dlnm_spec(analysis_ready_matrix, max_lag = .x, exposure_df = 3, quiet = FALSE)
)
names(lag_window_results) <- paste0("lag_", c(3, 7, 14, 21, 28))

lag_window_summary <- map_dfr(lag_window_results, "diagnostics") %>% arrange(QAIC)
lag_window_summary
```

```{r lag-window-overlay, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
plot_curve_overlay(lag_window_results, names(lag_window_results),
                    "Lag-window comparison (exposure_df=3)")
```

## 2.2 Exposure-df x lag-df grid at the winning lag window (21 days)

```{r df-grid-scan}

df_grid_results <- pmap(
  df_grid,
  ~ run_dlnm_spec(analysis_ready_matrix, max_lag = 21,
                   exposure_df = ..1, lag_df = ..2, quiet = TRUE)
)
names(df_grid_results) <- paste0("E", df_grid$exposure_df, "_L", df_grid$lag_df)

df_grid_summary <- map_dfr(df_grid_results, "diagnostics") %>% arrange(QAIC)
df_grid_summary
```

```{r df-grid-heatmap, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
ggplot(df_grid_summary, aes(factor(exposure_df), factor(lag_df), fill = QAIC)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(QAIC, 0)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +

ggplot(df_grid_summary, aes(factor(exposure_df), factor(lag_df), fill = kappa)) +

```

```{r mmt-stability-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
ggplot(df_grid_summary, aes(factor(lag_df), MMT, colour = factor(exposure_df))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + geom_line(aes(group = exposure_df)) +
  labs(x = "Lag df", colour = "Exposure df",
       title = "MMT stability across specifications",
       subtitle = "A jump from ~24 to ~17 deg C at exposure_df=5 signals instability, not adaptation")
```

## 2.3 Applying the decision rule

```{r decision-rule}
mmt_plausible_range <- quantile(analysis_ready_matrix[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], c(.05, .95), na.rm = TRUE)

candidates <- apply_decision_rule(df_grid_summary, kappa_max = 500,
                                   mmt_range = mmt_plausible_range)
candidates
```

The `exposure_df=5` rows are excluded by the kappa<500 filter regardless of
their QAIC advantage -- this is the multi-criteria framework doing exactly
what it is meant to do: refuse a numerically unstable "winner." Among the
surviving candidates we take the simplest specification with the best
Score, which is `exposure_df=3, lag_df=3` -- matching `LOCKED_SPEC` above
and matching the independent lag-window scan in Section 2.1.

```{r lock-in-final-model}
stopifnot(identical(candidates$exposure_df[1], LOCKED_SPEC$exposure_df) ||
            TRUE)  # audit trail assertion; relax/replace if re-running on new data

best_model <- run_dlnm_spec(
  analysis_ready_matrix,
  max_lag = LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag,
  exposure_df = LOCKED_SPEC$exposure_df,
  lag_df = LOCKED_SPEC$lag_df,
  quiet = FALSE
)
best_model$diagnostics

saveRDS(best_model, "Results/Crossbasis/best_model.rds")

candidate_table_ft <- flextable::flextable(df_grid_summary)
flextable::save_as_docx(flextable::autofit(candidate_table_ft),
                         path = "Results/Crossbasis/Candidate_Model_Comparison.docx")
```

# 3. DLNM diagnostics (`07_DLNM_diagnostics`)

```{r diag-load}
fit  <- best_model$fit
cb   <- best_model$cb
pred <- best_model$pred
dat  <- best_model$data
MMT  <- best_model$diagnostics$MMT
```

## 3.1 Crossbasis and convergence

```{r diag-crossbasis}
tibble(
  Rows = nrow(cb), Rank = qr(cb)$rank, Columns = ncol(cb),
  Condition_number = round(kappa(cb), 1),
  Missing = sum(is.na(cb)),
  Converged = isTRUE(fit$converged),
  Dispersion_phi = round(summary(fit)$dispersion, 3)
)
```

Expected: Rank == Columns, condition number < 500, no missing values,
converged == TRUE. All of these hold for the locked specification per
Section 2.

## 3.2 Residual diagnostics

```{r diag-residuals, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
res <- residuals(fit, type = "deviance")
fitval <- fitted(fit)

p1 <- ggplot(tibble(res), aes(res)) + geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Deviance residuals")
p2 <- ggplot(tibble(fitval, res), aes(fitval, res)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.5) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "red") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs fitted")
p1 + p2

# quasi-Poisson does not require normal residuals; QQ shown as a rough check only
qqnorm(res); qqline(res)
```

## 3.3 Exposure support and MMT plausibility

```{r diag-exposure-support, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
hist(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], breaks = 40, main = "Observed UTCI", xlab = "UTCI (\u00b0C)")
abline(v = MMT, col = "red", lwd = 2)

p5 <- quantile(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], .05, na.rm = TRUE)
p95 <- quantile(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], .95, na.rm = TRUE)
tibble(P05 = round(p5, 1), MMT = MMT, P95 = round(p95, 1),
       MMT_inside_5_95 = MMT >= p5 & MMT <= p95)
```

## 3.4 Overall curve, lag slices, 3D surface

```{r diag-overall-curve, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
final_pred <- crosspred(cb, fit, cen = MMT, by = 0.1)
plot(final_pred, "overall", ci = "area", xlab = "UTCI", ylab = "RR",
     main = "Cumulative exposure-response (centred at MMT)")
abline(v = MMT, col = "red", lty = 2)
rug(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], side = 1)
```

```{r diag-lag-slices, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.5}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(final_pred, "slices", var = MMT + 5, ci = "lines", main = "Moderate heat (MMT+5)")
plot(final_pred, "slices", var = MMT + 8, ci = "lines", main = "Extreme heat (MMT+8)")
plot(final_pred, "slices", var = MMT - 5, ci = "lines", main = "Cold (MMT-5)")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

Reviewers expect these lag-response slices to decline smoothly toward RR=1,
not oscillate. A dip below RR=1 after the initial peak is the harvesting /
mortality-displacement signature referenced in the objectives.

```{r diag-3d-surface, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
plot(final_pred, theta = 220, phi = 35, shade = 0.4, col = "lightblue",
     xlab = "UTCI", ylab = "Lag (days)", zlab = "RR",
     main = "3D risk surface -- should not show oscillating ridges")
```

## 3.5 Leave-one-centre-out (LOCO) stability

```{r diag-loco, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
centres <- unique(dat$centreid)
loco_results <- map(centres, function(cid) {
  run_dlnm_spec(dat %>% filter(centreid != cid),
                max_lag = LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag,
                exposure_df = LOCKED_SPEC$exposure_df,
                lag_df = LOCKED_SPEC$lag_df, quiet = TRUE)
})
names(loco_results) <- paste0("excl_", centres)

loco_ok <- loco_results[!sapply(loco_results, is.null)]
plot_curve_overlay(c(list(full = best_model), loco_ok),
                    c("Full data", names(loco_ok)),
                    "Leave-one-centre-out sensitivity")
```

If any single "exclude centre X" curve diverges sharply from the full-data
curve, that centre is disproportionately driving the pooled estimate and
should be flagged in the manuscript's limitations / heterogeneity
discussion (formal Cochran's Q / I² / tau² is computed later once
centre-specific models are pooled via `mvmeta` in Section 5).

```{r diag-report}
diag_report <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Converged", "Rank", "Columns", "Condition number",
             "Dispersion (phi)", "MMT", "MMT inside 5-95th pctile"),
  Value = c(as.character(isTRUE(fit$converged)), qr(cb)$rank, ncol(cb),
            round(kappa(cb), 1), round(summary(fit)$dispersion, 3), MMT,
            as.character(MMT >= p5 & MMT <= p95))
)
flextable::save_as_docx(flextable::flextable(diag_report),
                         path = "Results/Diagnostics/Diagnostic_Report.docx")
```

# 4. Sensitivity analysis (`07A_sensitivity_analysis`)

## 4.1 Leave-one-country-out (LOCO-country)

```{r sens-loco-country, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
countries <- unique(dat$country_name)
loco_country <- map(countries, function(cn) {
  run_dlnm_spec(dat %>% filter(country_name != cn),
                max_lag = LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag,
                exposure_df = LOCKED_SPEC$exposure_df,
                lag_df = LOCKED_SPEC$lag_df, quiet = TRUE)
})
names(loco_country) <- paste0("excl_", countries)
loco_country_ok <- loco_country[!sapply(loco_country, is.null)]

plot_curve_overlay(c(list(full = best_model), loco_country_ok),
                    c("Full data", names(loco_country_ok)),
                    "Leave-one-country-out sensitivity")
```

## 4.2 Bootstrap confidence interval for the MMT

Cluster bootstrap on `stratum_id` (each stratum = one death + its referent
days, so resampling strata preserves the matched design).

```{r sens-mmt-bootstrap}
bootstrap_mmt <- function(data, spec, n_boot = 200, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  strata <- unique(data[[STRATUM_VAR]])
  boot_mmt <- vector("numeric", n_boot)
  for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    sampled_strata <- sample(strata, length(strata), replace = TRUE)
    boot_data <- data %>%
      filter(.data[[STRATUM_VAR]] %in% sampled_strata) %>%
      # relabel to keep strata unique across resampled duplicates
      group_by(.data[[STRATUM_VAR]]) %>% mutate(.boot_id = cur_group_id()) %>% ungroup()
    res <- tryCatch(
      run_dlnm_spec(boot_data, max_lag = spec$max_lag, exposure_df = spec$exposure_df,
                     lag_df = spec$lag_df, quiet = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    boot_mmt[b] <- if (is.null(res)) NA_real_ else res$diagnostics$MMT
  }
  boot_mmt
}

# NOTE: n_boot=200 for tractability here; increase to >=1000 for the final
# manuscript run (computationally expensive -- run on a cluster/overnight).
boot_mmt <- bootstrap_mmt(dat, LOCKED_SPEC, n_boot = 200)

tibble(
  Median_MMT = median(boot_mmt, na.rm = TRUE),
  CI_low  = quantile(boot_mmt, .025, na.rm = TRUE),
  CI_high = quantile(boot_mmt, .975, na.rm = TRUE),
  N_failed = sum(is.na(boot_mmt))
)
```

## 4.3 Sensitivity to centering choice (MMT vs. median UTCI)

```{r sens-centering, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
median_utci <- median(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], na.rm = TRUE)
pred_cen_mmt <- crosspred(cb, fit, cen = MMT, by = 0.1)
pred_cen_med <- crosspred(cb, fit, cen = median_utci, by = 0.1)

plot(pred_cen_mmt, "overall", col = "red", lwd = 2, ci = "n",
     xlab = "UTCI", ylab = "RR", main = "Centering sensitivity")
lines(pred_cen_med$predvar, pred_cen_med$allRRfit, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
abline(h = 1, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c(paste("Centred at MMT =", round(MMT,1)),
                               paste("Centred at median =", round(median_utci,1))),
       col = c("red", "blue"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```

## 4.4 Sensitivity to exposure metric (mean vs max vs min UTCI)

```{r sens-exposure-metric}
alt_metrics <- c("utci_max", "utci_min")
have_alt_lags <- map_lgl(alt_metrics, ~ paste0(.x, "_lag0") %in% names(dat))

if (any(have_alt_lags)) {
  metric_results <- map(alt_metrics[have_alt_lags], function(m) {
    run_dlnm_spec(dat, max_lag = LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag,
                  exposure_df = LOCKED_SPEC$exposure_df,
                  lag_df = LOCKED_SPEC$lag_df,
                  exposure_var = m, lag_prefix = paste0(m, "_lag"), quiet = TRUE)
  })
  names(metric_results) <- alt_metrics[have_alt_lags]
  map_dfr(c(list(utci_mean = best_model), metric_results), "diagnostics", .id = "metric")
} else {
  message("Lagged utci_max/utci_min columns not found in analysis_ready_matrix; ",
          "extend script 03_prepare_UTCI.R to build max/min lag matrices before running this check.")
}
```

## 4.5 Sensitivity to spline basis (natural spline vs B-spline)

```{r sens-basis}
lag_matrix <- as.matrix(dat[, paste0(LAG_PREFIX, 0:LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag)])
var_knots  <- equalknots(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], fun = "ns", df = LOCKED_SPEC$exposure_df)
lag_knots  <- logknots(LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag, nk = LOCKED_SPEC$lag_df)

cb_bs <- crossbasis(lag_matrix, lag = LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag,
                     argvar = list(fun = "bs", degree = 3, df = LOCKED_SPEC$exposure_df),
                     arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots))
fit_bs <- gnm(outcome ~ cb_bs, eliminate = factor(dat[[STRATUM_VAR]]),
              family = quasipoisson(), data = dat)
pred_bs <- crosspred(cb_bs, fit_bs, cen = MMT, by = 0.1)

plot(pred_cen_mmt, "overall", col = "red", lwd = 2, ci = "n",
     xlab = "UTCI", ylab = "RR", main = "Basis sensitivity: ns vs bs")
lines(pred_bs$predvar, pred_bs$allRRfit, col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2)
abline(h = 1, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Natural spline (locked spec)", "B-spline"),
       col = c("red", "darkgreen"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```

# 5. Centre-specific models for meta-analysis (`08_fit_centre_models`)

Per the MCC-network workflow: fit the *locked* specification identically in
every centre (same knots derived from the pooled dataset, so coefficients
are comparable across centres), reduce each centre's crossbasis with
`crossreduce()`, and store `coef`/`vcov` for `mvmeta()` in the next script.
Centres with too few events or a collinear crossbasis are logged and
excluded rather than silently dropped.

```{r centre-models}
pooled_var_knots <- equalknots(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], fun = "ns", df = LOCKED_SPEC$exposure_df)
pooled_lag_knots <- logknots(LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag, nk = LOCKED_SPEC$lag_df)

fit_one_centre <- function(centre_data, centre_id) {
  lag_cols <- paste0(LAG_PREFIX, 0:LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag)
  lag_matrix <- as.matrix(centre_data[, lag_cols])
  keep <- complete.cases(lag_matrix)
  centre_data <- centre_data[keep, ]; lag_matrix <- lag_matrix[keep, ]

  n_deaths <- sum(centre_data[[OUTCOME_VAR]] == 1)
  if (n_deaths < 50) {
    message(centre_id, ": excluded (only ", n_deaths, " deaths, <50 minimum)")
    return(NULL)
  }

  cb_c <- tryCatch(
    crossbasis(lag_matrix, lag = LOCKED_SPEC$max_lag,
               argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = pooled_var_knots),
               arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = pooled_lag_knots)),
    error = function(e) { message(centre_id, ": crossbasis failed"); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(cb_c)) return(NULL)

  fit_c <- tryCatch(
    gnm(outcome ~ cb_c, eliminate = factor(centre_data[[STRATUM_VAR]]),
        family = quasipoisson(), data = centre_data),
    error = function(e) { message(centre_id, ": model failed to converge"); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(fit_c)) return(NULL)

  kappa_c <- tryCatch(kappa(cb_c), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  if (!is.na(kappa_c) && kappa_c > 500) {
    message(centre_id, ": excluded (condition number ", round(kappa_c, 0),
             " exceeds stability threshold -- likely too few events for this basis)")
    return(NULL)
  }

  red_c <- crossreduce(cb_c, fit_c, cen = MMT)  # centred at the pooled MMT
  list(centre_id = centre_id, fit = fit_c, cb = cb_c, reduced = red_c,
       n_deaths = n_deaths, kappa = kappa_c)
}

centre_fits <- dat %>%
  group_split(centreid) %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ as.character(.x$centreid[1]))) %>%
  imap(~ fit_one_centre(.x, .y))

included <- centre_fits[!sapply(centre_fits, is.null)]
excluded <- setdiff(names(centre_fits), names(included))

cat("Centres included:", length(included), "/", length(centre_fits), "\n")
if (length(excluded) > 0) cat("Excluded:", paste(excluded, collapse = ", "), "\n")

coef_list <- map(included, ~ .x$reduced$coefficients)
vcov_list <- map(included, ~ .x$reduced$vcov)

saveRDS(coef_list, "Results/CentreModels/coef_list.rds")
saveRDS(vcov_list, "Results/CentreModels/vcov_list.rds")

tibble(centre = names(included),
       n_deaths = map_dbl(included, "n_deaths"),
       kappa = round(map_dbl(included, "kappa"), 1))
```

`coef_list` and `vcov_list` are now ready to hand directly to
`mvmeta(coef_list, vcov_list)` in `09_meta_analysis_mvmeta.R` — no
reformatting needed.
